subject: Art and Culture in Bihar
description: Eduteria Bihar Tathya Sangrah · Art and Culture in Bihar

questions.q: The famous folk dance of Bihar is known as:
questions.source: Eduteria PYQ set — CDPO Preliminary Exam 2005 (BH-EDU-089)

questions.q: The painting of ‘Bodhisattva Padmapani’ is located at
Remains of Chandragupta Maurya's Rajprasad (palace with eighty pillars) have been found at:
questions.explanation: The remains of Chandragupta Maurya's Rajprasad, having a hall with eighty circular monolithic stone pillars, were excavated at Kumhrar in Patna.

questions.q: The famous Didarganj Yakshini statue was found from which city?
questions.explanation: The Yakshi (Streeratna) statue found from Didarganj in Patna, made of brown sandstone, is a fine Mauryan sculpture.

questions.q: Sher Shah Suri's mausoleum at Sasaram (1545 AD) is the best example of which architectural style in Bihar?
questions.explanation: The octagonal tomb of Sher Shah at Sasaram (1545 AD), built in the middle of a lake, is the best example of the Afghan style.

questions.q: The tomb of Shah Daulat at Maner (1617 AD), built in red sandstone by Ibrahim Khan Kakar, is the finest example of which style in Bihar?
questions.explanation: The tomb of Shah Daulat at Maner is the most beautiful example of the Mughal style of building in Bihar, built in 1617 AD.

questions.q: Which miniature-painting style emerged in the 18th century in Patna blending Mughal, British and local styles?
questions.explanation: 'Patna Kalam' emerged in 18th-century Patna from a mix of Mughal, British and local styles, and mainly produced miniature paintings on paper and ivory.

questions.q: Which folk painting of the Mithila region, popularized by women, uses natural colours and includes forms like Aripan?
questions.explanation: Madhubani painting, popularized by the women of Mithila, uses natural colours; its main forms are wall painting and Aripan.

questions.q: Which folk art of the Bhagalpur (Anga) region is based on the folk tale of Bihula-Vishhari?
questions.explanation: Manjusha painting, popular in Bhagalpur and the Anga region, depicts the Bihula-Vishhari folk tale in a sequential, chain form.

questions.q: Which folk song of Bihar is sung by young boys and girls during the month of Saavan?
questions.explanation: Kajri is sung by young boys and girls during Saavan. Chaita is sung in the month of Chait, and Phag during Holi.

questions.q: In which folk dance of Bihar do girls keep a perforated pot with a lit lamp on their head?
questions.explanation: In the Jhijhiya dance, the main girl balances a pot with a hole (containing a lit lamp) on her head and dances. It is performed by rural girls and women.

questions.q: Which folk drama, the work of Bhikhari Thakur, is presented by men assuming the forms of women?
questions.explanation: 'Videshiya', the famous work of Bhikhari Thakur, is the drama form of Launda dance, presented by men in the form of women.

questions.q: Which is the most important festival of Bihar, celebrated on the fifth and sixth day of Kartik month?
questions.explanation: Chhath Puja, the most important festival of Bihar, is celebrated on the fifth and sixth day of Kartik, worshipping the Sun and water.

questions.q: Asia's largest cattle fair (Sonepur Mela) is also known as:
questions.explanation: Sonepur Mela is locally known as the Harihar Kshetra Mela, Asia's largest cattle fair, held on the banks of the Gandak.
